title: Experiment plan: gesture recognition and medication intake detection

annotated_gestures.description: Isolated G1–G4 gesture trials (Subject01–15), one gesture per trial
annotated_gestures.use: training and validation (composed into continuous streams)

ingesture.description: Continuous 10-min recordings; drinking → G4, everything else → G5
ingesture.use: daily-life negatives (G5) for training; held-out participants for false alarms per hour

wisdm.description: Daily activities (WISDM 2019); everything → G5, eating treated as rest
wisdm.use: daily-life negatives (G5) for training; held-out participants for false alarms per hour

annotated_sequences.description: Lab protocol sessions; different people from annotated_gestures
annotated_sequences.use: BLIND TEST — never used for training or for selecting a configuration

splits.folds: 3 subject-wise folds over annotated_gestures (validation subjects never seen in training)

seeds.note: every number compared across configurations is a mean over 3 folds × 3 seeds; screening uses 3 folds × 1 seed

splits.external: InGesture/WISDM split by participant: train / calibration (25 %) / test (20 %), split_seed 42
splits.validation_streams: held-out gesture subjects composed inside external calibration participants, worlds W3int + W4long, identical for every configuration of every experiment

selection_rule.note: The annotated sequences are evaluated once per frozen configuration and never drive a choice.

fixed_unless_stated.augmentation: rotation ±30°, amplitude 0.8–1.25, time warp 0.8–1.25, noise, gyro bias, 5 % drop (conf/training.json)
fixed_unless_stated.training_steps: fixed per run regardless of overlap, so 75 % overlap (4× more windows) is not favoured by more updates
fixed_unless_stated.window_label: label of the window's centre sample (as in training)

metrics.timeline_without_postprocessing: window probabilities averaged onto the 10 Hz grid (each frame averages the windows covering it), argmax, then G1–G4 segments shorter than 0.5 × the 10th percentile of that gesture's duration in the training streams are given to the neighbour with the higher mean probability (E1, E2)
metrics.reporting: mean ± std over folds × seeds; paired Wilcoxon tests between configurations

experiments.name: Gesture classifier trained on annotated gestures only
experiments.question: Which model and signal configuration best recognises the individual gestures when training uses only the protocol gestures?
experiments.grid_size: 3 models × 3 fs × 5 windows × 4 overlaps × 2 signals × 2 filters = 720 configurations; × 3 folds × 3 seeds = 6480 trainings before the 64-point hyperparameter grid (≈ 415 000). Run in stages.

C_hyperparameters.n_configs: ≤ 192 (the CNN has no LSTM: its 32 duplicate points are skipped)
C_hyperparameters.advance: top 3 among the grid points and the default-hyperparameter B finalists

F_finalists.what: the 3 configurations chosen in C, completed to 3 folds × seeds 0–2

experiments.goal: Window-level precision, recall, F1 and accuracy per gesture; Gesture Timeline segmental F1; Gesture Order exact match
notes: Without external negatives, rest between gestures comes from the composed rest gaps, so the G5 class is still represented.
experiments.training_world: W0all: composed annotated gestures, all 11 scenario recipes, rest (G5 trials of the gesture folder) between gestures, no daily activity

experiments.name: Gesture classifier with daily-life negatives (G5)
experiments.question: Does adding daily-life movement (InGesture, WISDM) as G5 improve gesture recognition and reduce confusion with ordinary activity?
experiments.factors: same as E1 (same grid, folds and seeds, paired E1 × E2 comparison)
experiments.goal: Same as E1, plus G5 F1 and the rate of G1–G4 windows per hour on the InGesture/WISDM test participants
notes: InGesture and WISDM have their own sampling rates; resample to each fs in the grid.
experiments.training_world: W3int: gestures interleaved with daily activity of external training participants

experiments.name: Temporal post-processing (HMM, HSMM) and intake decision
experiments.question: Does HMM/HSMM post-processing on top of the best classifiers reconstruct the Gesture Timeline and Gesture Order and decide intake with few false alarms?
experiments.train_datasets: none — reuses the saved window probabilities of the selected E1/E2 runs (no retraining)
experiments.test_dataset: annotated_sequences, alone and embedded in daily activity of held-out external participants (test_wild)

models.short_window_references: best 0.75 s and 1 s configuration of E1 and of E2, each taken through B (3 models) -> C (hyperparameter grid) -> F (3 seeds) like the finalists (src/thesis/extra_windows.py, outputs/thesis/index/selection/<exp>_w<win>_<stage>.json); the best of each track is decoded in E3 with role 'window_ref'

intake_decision: LLR intake vs. no-intake (phased HMM, G3 mandatory)
threshold calibrated on validation under a false-alarm budget
experiments.goal: Window, Gesture Timeline and Gesture Order metrics after decoding; intake sensitivity, specificity and false alarms per hour
notes: fs, window, overlap and signals are fixed by the 6 selected models; E3 only sweeps the post-processing.
Configurations trained with 75 % overlap are also decoded from every second window (50 % stride).

implementation.decoding_grid: 10 Hz Gesture Timeline grid; emissions log(p/prior) per frame / temperature
implementation.self_transition: probability per second that rest (G5) continues: 0.8/0.9/0.95 = 5/10/20 s expected rest (HMM only)
implementation.min_duration_fraction: HMM chain length = fraction x 10th percentile of class duration; HSMM: relabel pass with these minima (0 = none)
implementation.overlap_variant: ov50 = every second window of the 75 % predictions (same model, 50 % stride)
implementation.durations: fitted on the validation streams' 10 Hz labels (training streams are stored only on the window grid)
intake_decisions: g3 (G3 segment in the decoded timeline)
g2_g3 (a G2 segment followed later by a G3 segment)
phased LLR on a 2 Hz grid, threshold per replicate on val + external calibration under fa_budget_per_hour
implementation.selection: grid point per (configuration, decoder) by mean val timeline.seg_f1_25, then best decoder per configuration
design_choices: rule_g2_g3 is an intake decision, not a timeline decoder
the top 3 configurations per experiment are taken from stage F
short-window tracks (0.75 s, 1 s) run through the whole pipeline
